item.title: SAVE Act Is Not a Voter ID Law
item.description: Jessica Tarlov’s repeated claim onThe Five (Fox News program) that the SAVE Act would force voters to “show their birth certificate or passport at the polls” is flat‑out false. Whether she’s misinformed or deliberately misleading viewers, the text of the bill does not say what she insists it does. During the segment, Tarlov argued: “…what the SAVE Act does is that it requires that you have either your birth certificate or your passport…”

item.title: Nuclear Energy Rejuvenation
item.description: Global momentum is building around nuclear energy with the International Atomic Energy Agency estimating that the world’s nuclear power capacity could more than double by 2050. In the US, a 2023 survey showed 57 percent want more nuclear plants, up from 43 percent in 2020. During the same period, support for nuclear in the Netherlands grew by half, with twice as many proponents now as opponents.

item.title: Democrats Fight Immigration Enforcement To Have A Future﻿
item.description: About a week ago, the Trump administration announced the withdrawal of 700 Federal Agents from Minnesota. This came as Immigration Czar Tom Holman went there to announce the drawdown and willingness to work with state and local political leaders. These gestures were met by heightened efforts to impede immigration enforcement.

item.title: Stop bailing out Canada Post
item.description: OTTAWA, ON: The Canadian Taxpayers Federation is calling on the federal government to end the bailouts for Canada Post after Ottawa announced another $1-billion so-called loan for the failing Crown corporation. “The government shouldn’t bail out Canada Post with taxpayers’ money,” said Franco Terrazzano, CTF Federal Director. “The last billion-dollar bailout didn’t solve anything at Canada Post so why would another billion-dollar bailout be any different?

item.title: Canadians wait, on average, more than 65 weeks longer for access to new medicines than Europeans and 90 weeks more than Americans
item.description: VANCOUVER—Canadian patients are waiting, on average, more than 65 weeks longer than Europeans and over 90 weeks more than Americans for access to new, potentially life-saving drugs, finds a new study released today by the Fraser Institute, an independent, non-partisan, Canadian public policy think-tank.

item.title: America’s Rainbow Mafia Super Bowl
item.description: The 2026 Super Bowl game was a great game. As a Seahawks fan, I was pleased with the outcome. However, it is too bad that the NFL bowed down to the San Francisco Bay Area Rainbow Mafia (all things LGBTQ+ and who knows what else). It was clear that the Rainbow Mafia had a major influence on the Super Bowl LX logo and the colors displayed around the stadium during the pregame period.

item.title: MP Dawson shows leadership by rejecting pay raise
item.description: OTTAWA, ON: The Canadian Taxpayers Federation is applauding member of Parliament Mike Dawson for rejecting the April 1 politician pay raise. “Dawson is showing real leadership and proving he is a true champion for taxpayers by turning down the upcoming MP pay raise,” said Franco Terrazzano, CTF Federal Director. “It takes courage to stand alone and do the right thing and Dawson is showing real guts to turn down this pay raise.
